Necessary investigations were done, he underwent 2 sessions of maintainence hemodialysis on 22nd and 25th January; On 28th he was brought to casuality with complaints of altered sensorium since 1 day (27th January); History of fever spike since 2 days, which are of high grade associated with chills and rigors, relieved upon taking after antipyretic medication. His PR 50bpm; BP 110\/80 mmHg; RR 22 cpm; GRBS 60mg\/dl, for which 25% dextrose was infused, then GRBS was 208 mg\/dl; GCS E3V3M5. His blood urea 127 and serum creatinine was 6.0, he was taken up for hemodialysis. His sensorium improved after hemodialysis and GCS was E4V4M6. His Blood urea 44 and serum creatinine 3.9 mg\/dl. He underwent another hemodialysis session on 29\/01\/23. He was started on oral antibiotic medications. He underwent maintainence hemodialysis on 1st, 3rd and 5th February. On 04\/02\/2023 his Hb was 7.2 gr\/dl; On 06\/02\/2023 at 12:16 AM, patient complained of sudden onset breathlessness, and was tachypnic; he was shifted to ICU and connected to ECG monitor, which showed ventricular fibrillation, immediately 360J of shock was deivered but as patient became unresponsive, central pulses were absent and BP was non recordable; immediately CPR was initiated according to ACLS guidelines and was intubated during CPR, CPR was continued for 30 minutes. Inspite of the above resuscitative efforts, the patient was declared dead at 12:59 AM, as ECG showed flat line with no electrical activity.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\" style=\"line-height: 1.38; She was diagnosed to be Hypertensive and started on antihypertensive medications. She started taking OTC NSAIDS, as she was having body pains and knee pains after coming from work, she usually takes 1 tablet every 3 to 4 days and also gets Diclophenac injections once in a while. After 1 year, she started having complaints of burning micturition and took medications from the practitioner and got relieved. At that time her BP was high and the antihypertensive which she was using previously has been changed( Nicardia 20mg\/OD). After 2 months, she started noticing decrease in urinary output and swelling of bilateral lower limbs that are not relieved on taking rest. After 8 months she had complaints of fever, nausea, vomiting and marked decrease in urinary output (less than previous output), for which she was taken to hospital by her son. There she underwent workup and diagnosed with renal failure and advised to undergo hemodialysis after staying in hospital for 3 days, as her edema was not resolving. She was initiated on henodialysis. She underwent 4 sessions of hemodialysis in our hospital and did not came for MHD. After 2 weeks she presented with complaints of facial puffiness and pedal edema till the level of thigh. In 2019, he had hypoglycemic attack and stopped using OHA'S.\u0026nbsp; he also stopped antihypertensive medications, after 6 months, as he was having dizziness, routine checkup was done at local clinic and he was informed that he was having high blood pressure. She started taking OTC NSAIDS, as she was having body pains and knee pains after coming from work, she usually takes 1 tablet every 3 to 4 days and also gets Diclophenac injections once in a while. After 1 year, she started having complaints of burning micturition and took medications from the practitioner and got relieved. At that time her BP was high and the antihypertensive which she was using previously has been changed( Nicardia 20mg\/OD). After 2 months, she started noticing decrease in urinary output and swelling of bilateral lower limbs that are not relieved on taking rest. After 8 months she had complaints of fever, nausea, vomiting and marked decrease in urinary output (less than previous output), for which she was taken to hospital by her son. There she underwent workup and diagnosed with renal failure and advised to undergo hemodialysis after staying in hospital for 3 days, as her edema was not resolving. She was initiated on henodialysis. She underwent 4 sessions of hemodialysis in our hospital and did not came for MHD. After 2 weeks she presented with complaints of facial puffiness and pedal edema till the level of thigh. She was initiated again on Maintainence hemodialysis.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\" style=\"line-height: 1.38; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
